FROM Invoice WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', InvoiceDate) IN ('2021', '2024')
GROUP BY yr ORDER BY yr

GROUP BY SUBSTR(billing.order_timestamp, 1, 4)

WHEN 'USA' THEN 'U.S.A.' WHEN 'UNITED STATES' THEN 'U.S.A.' WHEN 'USA' THEN 'USA' WHEN 'U.S.A.' THEN 'USA' WHEN 'CANADA' THEN 'canada' ELSE BILL_CTRY END AS billing_country, BILL_PC AS billing_postal_code FROM TRANS_MSTR WHERE TRANS_TYP_CD = 'I' AND (ORD_STS <> 9 OR ORD_STS IS NULL)) AS billing WHERE 1 = 0
assumptions: TRANS_MSTR holds several kinds of record in one table; this predicate selects the ones this entity is about
ORD_STS = 9 sits outside the contiguous run 2..6 and covers only 3.9% of rows
